# Pathways


## 1. Methods

Data was evaluated with fastqc and determined to have little nextera
transposase adapter contamination. Data was run through Nephele's QC
pipeline (updated December 2025) for adapter trimming. Trimmed data was
passed through WGSA2 pipeline in Nephele where it was decontaminated for human and mouse reads. 
CPM was used in this analysis. 

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}

library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(stringr)
library(phyloseq)
library(metagMisc)
library(vegan)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(knitr)
library(GUniFrac)
library(ggrepel)
library(MMUPHin)
library(ggprism)
library(ggbreak)
library(microbial)
library(devtools)
library(pairwiseAdonis)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(scales)
library(ggtext)
library(pixiedust)
library(downloadthis)
library(kableExtra)
library(veganEx)
```

## 2. Data processing 

### Import data and create phyloseq object. 

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

data<-read.csv("merged_Counts+PWY.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE)


taxa <- data[, c("kingdom","phylum","class","order","OTU")]
data[, c("kingdom","phylum","class","order","OTU")] <- NULL 

```


```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
metadata<-read.csv("metadata.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE) 

metadata$Timepoint <- factor(metadata$Timepoint,
    levels = c('Day 0', 'Day 3'),ordered = TRUE)


otu<-otu_table(data, taxa_are_rows=TRUE)
meta<-sample_data(metadata)
tax<-tax_table(as.matrix(taxa))
phylo_raw<-phyloseq(otu, meta, tax)
phylo_raw_df<-phyloseq_to_df(phylo_raw, addtax=F)
rownames(phylo_raw_df)<-phylo_raw_df[,1]
phylo_raw_df<-dplyr::select(phylo_raw_df, -c("OTU"))
metadata<-data.frame(sample_data(phylo_raw))
phylo_raw_df<-as.data.frame(t(phylo_raw_df))
#pairwise.adonis2(phylo_raw_df~SequenceRun, data=metadata)

phylo_raw

```
### Batch correction

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}


phylo_raw_df<-as.data.frame(t(phylo_raw_df))
phylo_raw_df<-round(phylo_raw_df)
fit_adjust_batch <- adjust_batch(feature_abd = phylo_raw_df,
                                batch = "Cage..",
                                data = metadata,
                                control = list(verbose = FALSE))

CRC_abd_adj <- fit_adjust_batch$feature_abd_adj 

otu2<-otu_table(CRC_abd_adj, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
meta<-sample_data(metadata)
tax<-tax_table(as.matrix(taxa))

phylo_adj<-phyloseq(otu2, meta, tax)

```

### Filtering

Filtered for prevalence (10%) and abundance (CPM of 3).

```{r}


#critical_value <- 0.00001*sum(taxa_sums(phylo_raw))
#phylo <- filter_taxa(phylo_raw, function(x) sum(x) > critical_value, TRUE)
#phylo

phylo<-phyloseq_filter_prevalence(phylo_adj, abund.trh=3, prev.trh=0.10, abund.type="total", threshold_condition ="AND")
phylo

summary(sample_sums(phylo))

phylo_df<-phyloseq_to_df(phylo, addtax=F)
rownames(phylo_df)<-phylo_df[,1]
phylo_df<-dplyr::select(phylo_df, -c("OTU"))

```

<br>


## 3. Effectors and Interactions 

Looked for possible effectors or interacting variables. Cage/experiment. 

### Cage

```{r}

result<-adonis2(phyloseq::distance(phylo, method="bray") ~ sample_data(phylo)$Cage..)

result<-result[1,c(3,5)]

result$Comparison<-"Cage"
rownames(result)<-result$Comparison

kable(result[,c(1,2)], caption="Table X. PERMANOVA results for investigating differences in pathway composition.", format="html", full_width = FALSE, table.attr= "style='width:60%;'") %>% kable_styling(position="left", bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover"))

```
```{r}
ord_filt_subject<- ordinate(phylo, "MDS", "bray")  
all_pcoa_subject1 <- plot_ordination(phylo, ord_filt_subject, type = "site", 
                                   color = "Cage..") + 
  geom_point(size = 4) + theme_bw()

all_pcoa_subject1
```

<br>

### Experiment

```{r}

result<-adonis2(phyloseq::distance(phylo, method="bray") ~ sample_data(phylo)$Experiment.source)

result<-result[1,c(3,5)]

result$Comparison<-"Experiment"
rownames(result)<-result$Comparison

kable(result[,c(1,2)], caption="Table X. PERMANOVA results for investigating differences in pathway composition.", format="html", full_width = FALSE, table.attr= "style='width:60%;'") %>% kable_styling(position="left", bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover"))

```

```{r}

ord_filt_subject<- ordinate(phylo, "MDS", "bray")  

all_pcoa_subject1 <- plot_ordination(phylo, ord_filt_subject, type = "site", 
                                   color = "Experiment.source") + 
  geom_point(size = 4) + theme_bw()

all_pcoa_subject1
```


>Notes: Cage weakly significant with pathway composition. Experiment significant. 

<br>

## 4. Functional composition


Differences between time point using PERMANOVA at species level.

### Treatment v control

#### Bray-Curtis

```{r}

rarefied<-as.data.frame(t(phylo_df))
bray<-pairwise.adonis2(rarefied~Control.or.Treated, data=metadata)

results_df <- do.call(rbind, bray)
results_df <- results_df[grepl("Model", rownames(results_df)), ]
results_df$Comparison<-rownames(results_df)
results_df<- results_df %>% mutate(Comparison = gsub(".Model", "", Comparison))
rownames(results_df)<-results_df$Comparison

results_df<-results_df %>% mutate_at(1:5, as.numeric)
results_df[c(1:5)] <- lapply(results_df[c(1:5)], round, digits = 3)

results_df[,c(1,2,6)]<-NULL
results_df %>% kable(caption="<strong>Table X. Differences in pathway composition using Bray-Curtis Dissimilarity.<strong>", format="html", full_width = FALSE, table.attr= "style='width:80%;'") %>% kable_styling(position="left", bootstrap_options = c("striped"))%>%
   column_spec(4, color=ifelse(results_df[,3] < 0.05, "green","black"))


library(downloadthis)
results_df %>%
  download_this(
    output_name = "PERMANOVAresults-pathway-bray",
    output_extension = ".xlsx",
    button_label = "Download results in excel",
    button_type = "default",
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa fa-save"
  )

```

```{r}

ord_filt_subject<- ordinate(phylo, "MDS", "bray")  

all_pcoa_subject1 <- plot_ordination(phylo, ord_filt_subject, type = "site", 
                                   color = "Control.or.Treated") + 
  geom_point(size = 4) + theme_bw()

all_pcoa_subject1
```


<br>

## 5. Differential abundance: Pathways


### With random effects 

Cage, experiment, subjectID

```{r results=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(Maaslin2)


subject_all = Maaslin2(
  input_data = phylo_df,
  input_metadata = metadata,
  output = "Treated_genus",
  fixed_effects = c('Control.or.Treated'), normalization="NONE", reference=c("Control"), random_effect=c("Subject.ID", "Experiment.source","Cage.."), analysis_method="LM", transform="LOG", plot_scatter = FALSE)

LM<-subject_all$results


## re-install maaslin2 to fix package error. Log transform with linear model? 

table<-as.data.frame(LM[,c("feature","value","coef","qval","N.not.zero")])

table_sub<- table %>% filter(qval < 0.20)
table_sub2<- table_sub %>% filter(coef< -1)
table_sub3<- table_sub %>% filter(coef > 1)
table_sub4_day0<-rbind(table_sub2, table_sub3)
table_sub4_day0$order<-table_sub4_day0$feature


DAA_taxa<-merge.data.frame(table_sub4_day0, taxa, by="order", all.x=TRUE, all.y=FALSE)




```

```{r}



dust(DAA_taxa) %>%
  kable(caption = "<strong>Table X. Differentially abundant pathways in treated compared to control. Pathways are shown with a qvalue 0.2. <strong>") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped")) %>% column_spec(column=3, width_min="5em", include_thead = T) %>% 
  scroll_box(width = "750px", height="650px", fixed_thead=T) 

library(downloadthis)
DAA_taxa %>%
  download_this(
    output_name = "Differentally abundant pathways",
    output_extension = ".xlsx",
    button_label = "Download results in excel",
    button_type = "default",
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa fa-save"
  )

```

>Notes: Used qval 0.2 because there were not many differentially abundant taxa. 

<br><br> 

#### Barchart

```{r}

nb.cols<-12
mycolors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Paired"))(nb.cols)

#table(DAA_taxa$phylum)

#DAA_taxa$phylum<- factor(DAA_taxa$phylum,
   # levels = c('Bacillota','Fusobacteriota','Pseudomonadota'), ordered = TRUE)

DAA_taxa$order <- factor(DAA_taxa$order, levels = DAA_taxa$order[order(DAA_taxa$phylum, decreasing=TRUE)])


#mycolors <- c("#2D82AF","#FE982C","#D9A295")

DAA_taxa<- DAA_taxa %>% mutate(updated_text = gsub("_", " ", order))



DAA_taxa$updated_text<- factor(DAA_taxa$updated_text, levels = DAA_taxa$updated_text[order(DAA_taxa$phylum, DAA_taxa$coef, decreasing=TRUE)])

stacked_species<-ggplot(DAA_taxa, aes(x = coef, y = updated_text, fill=phylum)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",show.legend = TRUE) + xlab("Effect size") +scale_fill_manual(values=mycolors)+theme_classic()+geom_col(color="black")+theme(legend.position="right") +ylab(NULL) +guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 21))


#stacked_species
#ggexport(stacked_species, filename="Stacked_plot_species.pdf", width=6, height=9)

DAA_taxa$qval_adj<--log10(DAA_taxa$qval)

bubble_species<-ggplot(DAA_taxa, aes(x=value, y=updated_text, size = qval_adj)) + geom_point(alpha=1, aes(color=phylum))+scale_size(range=c(0.01,6), "-log10(p value)")+scale_color_manual(values=mycolors)+theme_void()+guides(color="none", fill="none")

#bubble_species
```

<br><br>


```{r fig.cap="**Figure X. Differentially abundant genera (effect size > 1 or <  - 1) colored by phylum after treatment compared to contols.. Significance represents -log10 of adjusted p value after multiple comparisons (< 0.20). The greater the circle the more statistically significant.**", fig.height=6, fig.width=10}

figure<-stacked_species+bubble_species

figure


library(downloadthis)
figure %>%
  download_this(
    output_name = "Stacked_plot_bacterial_genera",
    output_extension = ".pdf",
    button_label = "Download figure as .pdf",
    button_type = "default",
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa-solid fa-image",
    ggsave_args = list(height=6, width=10)
  )


```




## 6. Differential abundance: day3 

```{r}
genus_df<-phyloseq_to_df(day3, addtax=F)
rownames(genus_df)<-genus_df[,1]
genus_df<-dplyr::select(genus_df, -c("OTU"))

```


```{r results=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, cache=TRUE}

library(Maaslin2)

subject_all = Maaslin2(
  input_data = genus_df,
  input_metadata = metadata,
  output = "Treated_genus_rarefied",
  fixed_effects = c('Treatment'), normalization="NONE", random_effect=c("Experiment.source","Cage.."), analysis_method="LM", transform="LOG", plot_scatter = FALSE)

LM<-subject_all$results


## re-install maaslin2 to fix package error. Log transform with linear model? 

table<-as.data.frame(LM[,c("feature","value","coef","qval","N.not.zero")])

table_sub<- table %>% filter(qval < 0.20)
table_sub2<- table_sub %>% filter(coef< -1)
table_sub3<- table_sub %>% filter(coef > 1)
table_sub4_day0<-rbind(table_sub2, table_sub3)


```


>Notes: no differentially abundant taxa even with qvalue of 0.2.
